courses.name: Your money, plainly
courses.why: Everyone earns, spends, saves and borrows, and most people are never taught how risk, interest and markets actually work.
units: What money is and what it is for
Saving, interest and the long game
Risk and insurance: paying so the bad day is survivable
Stocks, bonds and funds in plain words
Why smart people still make money mistakes
Banks, runs and bubbles: how the system breaks
Scams, fees and who is selling to you

courses.name: Old thrift, new rules
courses.why: Old thrift books teach habits (waste nothing, count small costs) that still beat most modern money advice.
units: Why small spending leaks sink people
The frugal home: making things last
What changed since then and what did not

courses.name: How the money world works and fails
courses.why: Crashes, bailouts and big banks shape jobs and homes, and a citizen should understand them to vote and decide.
units: Collateral and why leverage is dangerous
Reform: rules that worked and did not
Other people's money: the old warnings
